verdict.rationale: The README states skills trigger automatically with no special action needed (gh-11). A SessionStart bootstrap tells the agent to invoke relevant skills before any response, including routing examples such as "Fix this bug" → systematic-debugging (docs-20, docs-26, docs-16, docs-77), and auto-triggering is documented across harnesses like Devin and Antigravity (docs-7, gh-8, docs-59). Activation reliability is engineered through TDD-style pressure testing of skills and an eval harness that judges skill compliance (docs-15, docs-76, docs-30). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how skill description/frontmatter text is crafted for triggering accuracy, and independent hands-on corroboration that the right skill fires at the right moment.
